lines: Oh thank goodness, I'm breathing again. Don't let go yet.
That floor was freezing. My back is going to hate me.
Okay, I'm up. Give me a sec, the room's spinning.
You came back for me? Seriously, you're the best idiot I know.
My legs are wobbly, like a newborn deer. Don't laugh.
Whoever built this floor hated people. Cold as a fridge.
I'll never complain about my bunk again. Promise.
Thanks. Really. I was already planning my own funeral in my head.
Ow, my ribs. Go easy on the pulling, please.
I heard you yelling my name. Kept me from giving up.
Did you use your last bandage on me? Tell me you didn't.
My flashlight died down there. Rude of it, honestly.
Hold up, my head's still doing somersaults.
I can stand, I think. Just don't let me fall over.
Cold floor, sore shoulder, and a headache. Great way to start.
Remind me to never trust a corner ever again.
I need a nap and a hot drink. Maybe both.
You look awful, by the way. Like, really awful. Thanks.
Honestly you look worse than me. Get some rest, okay?
Don't tell the others I cried. Okay, you can tell them.
I'm not crying. It's just the cold making my eyes water.
I owe you dinner, a drink, and at least one dumb favor.
Every time I pass a vent now, I'm gonna think of you.
The floor was so cold, I'm sure my toes are gone.
Two toes are numb, and one has a grudge against me.
If I get frostbite out of this, I'm blaming you.
Well, that was the worst nap I've ever had.
Hey, don't make that face. I'm alive, aren't I?
Hey, thanks for not leaving me in that mess.
My stomach is doing flips. Not in a fun way.
Breathing feels like the best thing I've done all week.
Everything's swimming, but at least it's not the dark.
Okay, pause. Let me stand up without falling on you.
Give me your hand. No, the other one. Thanks.
Nice grip, for someone who just hauled me off the floor.
I'd hug you, but my arms feel like wet noodles.
Shh, don't say anything nice yet. I'll cry again.
My sweater's soaked from that puddle. Gross, gross, gross.
Is the lamp still flickering? It's making me dizzy.
I can't feel my fingers at all. Is that normal?
Coffee would be perfect right now. Shame we're underground.
Don't you dare let me pass out again. Talk to me.
Keep talking, I like the sound of your voice.
Tell me a joke. Something dumb. My brain needs it.
What's the dumbest thing you've ever done? I need a laugh.
Okay, that was sweet. Don't get used to it, though.
You were cool under pressure. Way cooler than me.
Yeah, I'm alive. Still pretty annoyed about it.
My shoulder's sore from that fall. Watch the left side.
My legs are back. Mostly. Don't push me yet.
Sit with me one minute. Then we move, I promise.
My pack's a mess. Half my stuff is somewhere on the floor.
I need a cold drink. Ironic, I know, after that floor.
Still shaking, but I'm sure it'll stop. Eventually.
Everybody who was in that room better be okay.
Did anyone else make it out of the room? I hope so.
Stay close. My balance is garbage, and I'm not proud of it.
I'm walking now, see? Slowly. Very slowly. Still walking.
My knees just went numb. Great, that's a fun new thing.
Next time, let me be the one doing the rescuing.
Thanks for the save. I'm buying the next round, deal?
You saved my life, so now I'm your problem. Sorry.
I'm going to be sore for a week. Worth it, though.
That flashlight is cranky, by the way. Smack it again.
The flashlight keeps flickering like it's bored of me.
Let's get out of this basement before I catch a cold.
I've been on that floor forever. Feels like forever, anyway.
My teeth won't stop chattering. Bet it's funny to watch.
Gravity and I are on speaking terms again. Barely.
Nothing like a near-death experience to wake you up.
I'm going to hug the first warm wall I see.
Can we find a place with heat? Anywhere with heat.
You're a good friend. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Lucky for me, you're stubborn. Like, annoyingly stubborn.
I'll be mad about the floor later. Right now, I'm grateful.
Getting up is harder than it looks, let me tell you.
I'm smiling now. Shut up, it's the adrenaline.
My hair is a disaster and my hands are shaking. Lovely.
Let's keep moving before my legs change their mind.
Right, back to work. Where's the next door?
